d: Our client is looking for a detail-oriented Freight Management Executive to support shipment execution and tracking across its freight operations.
The role will coordinate container bookings, monitor shipments, manage operational exceptions, support freight rate negotiations, and keep freight records and reconciliations accurate.
q: Experience in freight, shipping, logistics, or supply chain operations.
Familiarity with container bookings, freight forwarders, shipping lines, and shipment tracking.
Understanding of vessel schedules, ETA/ETD updates, transshipments, and shipment milestones.
Experience with freight rate comparisons, invoice checks, or account reconciliations.
Strong coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage operational exceptions.
Good attention to detail and confidence maintaining trackers, dashboards, and records.
Clear communication skills when working with suppliers, planners, freight forwarders, and internal teams.
r: Ensure container bookings are made in line with freight forwarder commitments.
Coordinate daily operational calls with suppliers, freight forwarders, and planners to track shipments.
Monitor containers in transit, including vessel movements, ETAs and ETDs, transshipments, and key milestones.
Maintain shipment visibility dashboards, exception logs, and escalation trackers.
Coordinate planner requests for changes of destination (COD) and shipment termination.
Coordinate shipments using the Oman–UAE land bridge.
Prepare information for freight RFQs and comparative analyses to support negotiations with freight forwarders and shipping lines.
Maintain agreed freight rates by month or shipment, along with freight agreement records.
Work with the documentation team to validate supplier invoices against agreed rates and supporting documents.
Perform regular statement of account (SOA) reconciliations and maintain accurate records.
Review freight forwarder performance against agreed service levels and follow up on issues.

d: Oman Investment Bank is creating a new benchmark for investment banking in the region. Backed by the Government of Oman and guided by internationally experienced professionals, we are building a leading corporate investment bank that connects local opportunity with global markets. As part of our growth journey, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals who are driven by excellence, innovation and impact. Joining Oman Investment Bank means becoming part of a purpose-led organisation that is helping to deliver the objectives of Oman Vision 2040 while offering exceptional opportunities for professional development, international exposure and long-term career growth.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Banking, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional certification such as CIA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent is highly preferred.
0 – 3 years of relevant experience in banking, financial markets, Treasury, FX sales, Transaction Banking, or Trade Finance.
Client-facing banking experience and strong quantitative academic performance are advantages.
Excellent numerical aptitude and mathematical accuracy (essential).
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and Excel proficiency.
Ability to learn banking products and financial markets quickly.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence interacting with corporate clients.
Professional client-service approach; English fluency, with Arabic highly desirable.
Clear long-term career ambition in banking and financial markets.
Ownership, initiative, resilience, adaptability, and strong work ethic.
Ability to perform under pressure, prioritize competing demands, and meet tight deadlines.
Flexibility to work extended hours when business requirements demand.
r: The Sales Assistant Specialist – Transaction Banking will support the team in managing and servicing the bank’s existing corporate and institutional client portfolio. The role will primarily focus on FX transactions, with increasing involvement in Trade Finance products as the business develops. The role must combine strong mathematical aptitude with excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage demanding workloads and tight deadlines. You will be responsible for :
Support the team in servicing the existing corporate and institutional client portfolio, handling daily requests, inquiries, and high transaction volumes.
Support clients across Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, and Documentary Collections.
Coordinate with Relationship Managers, Treasury, Operations, Compliance, and Product teams; escalate operational issues and client concerns appropriately.
Assist in managing and developing client relationships, negotiating the terms of business and enhancing the service solution.
Prepare transaction volume reports, client activity summaries, and management updates, and perform financial analysis.
Maintain complete and accurate transaction and client records, including onboarding files for audit and regulatory purposes.
Maintain in-depth knowledge of market practices, regulatory developments, and competitive offerings across the GCC, Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, and CIS.
Assist your management in building segment-specific propositions for high-priority industries (e.g., agriculture, fertilizers, metals and mining, real estate, tourism, FMCG etc).

Assist in preparing for and representing the bank at client meetings, regional industry forums, and transaction banking conferences by compiling briefing materials, presentations, and follow-up action items.
x: In addition, expatriate employees will receive a relocation allowance and annual return flights for themselves and their eligible dependants

d: Blitzed is a crypto casino built around entertainment, creators and degen internet culture. We’re early, funded and moving quickly.
Our custom-built product is live. We’re building a brand people want to follow and a community they want to be part of.
We’re looking for an ambitious, hands-on marketer to work directly with the CEO and take ownership of a broad range of marketing activity.
You’ll turn business priorities into campaigns, organise delivery and drive work through to completion.
This is a startup role with a broad remit. You’ll plan and execute campaigns yourself, coordinate internal team members and freelancers, and take responsibility for results across multiple channels.

We need someone who can take an objective, work out what needs doing and get it delivered without constant oversight. You’ll help shape the strategy, bring your own ideas and make day-to-day decisions within agreed priorities and budgets.
You should understand crypto, casino and internet culture, with the commercial judgment to turn that understanding into campaigns that attract and retain players.
q: Experience owning and delivering multi-channel digital marketing campaigns in iGaming, crypto or a closely related business.
A strong marketing generalist who is comfortable planning, executing, analysing results and coordinating others.
Able to take a broad objective and turn it into delivered work without needing detailed instructions.
Strong understanding of crypto, casino, streaming and internet culture.
Strong written English and the ability to produce engaging content without sounding corporate or relying on generic AI copy.
Commercial awareness, with the ability to look beyond clicks and impressions to understand player quality and financial results.
Understanding of how acquisition, product marketing, CRM and community activity fit together.
Experience coordinating colleagues, freelancers or external partners to deliver campaigns.
Organised, proactive and accountable, with sound judgment about priorities and when to escalate.
Comfortable wearing multiple hats in a fast-moving, ambitious startup.
r: Plan and deliver campaigns across marketing activations, paid media, CRM, content, creators and affiliates, taking direct ownership of activity as required.
Turn company priorities into clear plans, briefs, deadlines and measurable targets.
Own the marketing calendar and keep campaigns and projects moving.
Coordinate relevant team members, freelancers and partners, ensuring work is delivered on time and to a high standard.
Work with product, operations and marketing colleagues to deliver launches, promotions and updates.
Write and review campaign copy, briefs and promotional messaging that fit the Blitzed brand.
Track campaign spend and analyse player acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue to assess performance.
Test new ideas, improve underperforming activity and build repeatable processes around what works.
Proactively identify gaps, resolve problems and keep leadership informed of results and decisions requiring input.
x: 25 days’ annual leave plus applicable public holidays.
Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful ownership.
Fast progression, with room to grow and take on greater responsibility as Blitzed scales.

d: GSS Tech Group is hiring on behalf of our client, a new premium ladies only fitness and wellness studio in Dubai offering Strength, Pilates and Lagree, alongside a dedicated wellness and spa space. The studio is building a community driven brand and is hiring its founding management team ahead of launch.

The Studio Operations Manager owns everything that happens on the studio floor. You will build and run the class timetable, manage the instructor rota, oversee bookings and capacity, keep every studio ready for class, and deliver events that grow the studio’s community. Beyond the studio floor, you are accountable for the overall running of the facility, including every supplier, delivery and service that comes into the building.
q: Available to join immediately or within 30 days, currently based in the UAE
3 to 5 years in studio, gym or fitness operations, with at least 1 to 2 years in a supervisory role
Hands on experience with boutique fitness formats; Pilates, reformer or Lagree knowledge is a strong advantage
Experience scheduling instructors and managing booking platforms (Mindbody, Glofox, Mariana Tek or similar)
Pre opening or studio launch experience is a big plus
Experience managing suppliers, vendors, stock or facilities in a fitness, spa, hospitality or retail setting
Strong organisational, people and problem solving skills
Comfortable with data: utilisation, attendance and occupancy reporting
Flexible to work early mornings, evenings and weekends
r: Design and optimise the weekly timetable across Strength, Pilates and Lagree based on demand and utilisation
Analyse attendance, waitlists and peak times to adjust class mix and capacity
Plan timetable launches, seasonal changes and Ramadan schedules
Build and manage instructor schedules, cover and substitutions
Coordinate with instructors on availability, class formats and quality standards
Support instructor recruitment, onboarding and performance tracking with the GM
Oversee the booking system: class capacity, waitlists, no shows and late cancellations
Monitor occupancy and booking trends, and report insights to the GM
Work with front desk to resolve booking issues and protect member experience
Ensure every studio, reformer, Lagree machine and piece of equipment is clean, safe and class ready
Manage equipment maintenance schedules and liaise with service providers
Enforce health, safety and hygiene standards across studios, changing rooms and wellness areas
Act as the main point of contact for all suppliers, vendors and service providers serving the studio
Oversee everything that enters the building: equipment, retail stock, spa and wellness products, amenities, cleaning supplies and consumables
Coordinate deliveries, check orders on arrival, and resolve shortages, damages or quality issues with suppliers
Manage service contracts and schedules for cleaning, maintenance, pest control, security and other outsourced services
Track stock levels and reorder before items run out, working with the Admin Coordinator on purchase orders and invoices
Own the day to day running of the entire facility, not just classes: studios, reception, changing rooms, wellness and spa areas
Coordinate across all teams and partners, including instructors, front desk, spa staff, cleaners, contractors and suppliers, so the studio runs as one operation
Identify and fix operational gaps before they affect members, escalating to the GM where needed
Set and maintain operating procedures, opening and closing checklists and daily standards across the studio
Be the go to person for any operational issue in the building
Plan and run launch events, community classes, workshops and brand collaborations
Coordinate with marketing on event promotion and member engagement
Track event attendance and conversion to memberships
x: Opportunity to join a premium brand as part of its founding management team
Competitive package, details shared at interview stage
